answer: Honest holders refresh their bond by working; forgers watch theirs rot. An identity bond of 200 credits earns nothing and loses 2 percent per epoch, so after 25 idle epochs it is worth barely 120. Honest work resets the decay, and the harbor of real activity keeps the bond whole. Forgers must either work each clone or accept the bleed. The terrace of idle bonds falls steadily: 1,000 untouched bonds lose 4,000 credits of value per epoch. The gale of decay never pauses. After 50 epochs a forgotten bond is worth 72 credits, and proven fakes lose the bond entirely.
